chapters.reason: Demonstrates and analyzes the capabilities of the proposed embedding-based search approach to enhance multi-step reasoning and symbolic-like problem solving in LLMs.
Relates to information flow and chain-of-embedding trajectories; the paper's embedding-guided reasoning touches cross-layer information propagation and embedding trajectories.
Uses embedding-based approaches with perturbations in the embedding space, aligning with the embedding-centric diffusion-like paradigm described in this leaf category.
